manifest.physical_independence: Unverified where physical_plate_id and group_id are null; registration text is metadata and is not used to infer plate identity.

rectangular_positional_interpolation.implementation: Built-in learned patch positional embeddings are reshaped to their square training grid and interpolated to (height // patch_height, width // patch_width).

processor.size_default: SizeDict(height=None, width=None, longest_edge=None, shortest_edge=256, max_height=None, max_width=None)
processor.crop_size_default: SizeDict(height=224, width=224, longest_edge=None, shortest_edge=None, max_height=None, max_width=None)

budget_policy.status: experimental choices; not established optimal values

representation_rules.r0_cls: Whole-plate CLS from the shared whole forward output.
representation_rules.r1_mean_patch: Uniform mean of spatial patch tokens intersecting unpadded resized content; padding-only excluded; partial included; then L2-normalized.

r2_global_regional.concatenation_equivalence: Concatenate each normalized 384-D component scaled by sqrt(0.25)=0.5; the resulting 1536-D vector has unit norm and its cosine equals the weighted score.

representation_rules.r3_marker_cls: CLS of exact supplied marker xyxy crop; seven eligible images only.

marker_visual_review.4: The supplied box visibly contains both NT letters; no coordinate clipping is visible.
marker_visual_review.5: The corrected supplied box is in bounds and visibly contains both NT marker characters; no coordinate clipping is visible.
marker_visual_review.6: The supplied box covers the small left-side Shorta marking, but the 23x17 crop is very low resolution and tightly framed; visual completeness is uncertain.
marker_visual_review.7: The supplied box covers the small left-side Shorta marking, but the 27x20 crop is very low resolution and tightly framed; visual completeness is uncertain.
marker_visual_review.8: The supplied box visibly contains the complete Tunis text marker.
marker_visual_review.9: The supplied box visibly contains the complete Tunis text marker.
marker_visual_review.10: The supplied box visibly contains the complete Tunis text marker.

region_rounding: Original-crop lower x bounds use floor; upper x bounds use ceil; all bounds clamped; full source height retained.

evaluation_policy.similarity: cosine; R2 is fixed weighted corresponding-component cosine
evaluation_policy.group_exclusion: exclude matching non-null physical_plate_id or group_id
evaluation_policy.tie_resolution: smallest numerical reference ID while tie_flag remains true
